chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hasham ibn Salim, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Among those who claim this Command (Wilayah), there are those who lie, to the extent that Satan would be in need of their lie.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the liars that claim Wilayah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) uses hyperbole to emphasize the profound depth of deception among those who falsely claim Wilayah, noting that their lies are so convincing that even Satan would need to rely on them. This highlights the critical Shia concept of distinguishing true authority from impostors in times of occultation or political turmoil. The reference to Satan underscores the spiritual dimension of this deception, linking it to the broader theme of divine guidance versus human fallibility.
